description: Creates a new API key for yourself in this agency, limited to the requested scopes, and returns the secret once. Readers cannot get write scopes, only the agency owner can get billing:write, and a delegated key cannot issue a key broader than itself. Each call creates another key (up to 20 active per user).

scopes.description: Scopes to grant, from the supported agency set (for example workspaces:read, agents:write, billing:read).

name: agency_profile_issue_key
title: Issue Agency API Key
